༄༅/ /bde mchog bstod chen dngos grub 'byung gnas bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bde mchog bstod chen dngos grub 'byung gnas bzhugs/

oṃ gu ru tsakrā nan+tā dhi pa ti sha da ku le shwa ra badz+ra ā tsar+ya na mo na maḥ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa bde ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la bstod pa dngos grub 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ bcom ldan dpa' bo'i dbang phyug chen po ni/ /bskal pa chen po'i me dang mnyam pa'i 'od/ /ral pa gyen du brdzes pa'i cod pan can/ /mche ba gtsigs pa drag po 'jigs pa'i zhal/ /gzi brjid ldan pa stong phrag phyag dag gis/ /dgra sta zhags pa mdung gdengs kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /bsnams shing stag gi pags pa'i na bza' 'dzin/ /dud kha mun nag chen po'i sku la 'dud/ /hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa oṃ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo 'phags ma ni/ /gzhan gyis mi thub 'jig rten gsum yum rig ma ste/ /dbang phyug 'byung po'i 'jigs pa kun sel rdo rje che/ /rdo rje gdan ma mi pham dbang mdzad gzhan mi rgyal/ /spyan 'phrul dug skem drag mo khro bo mche gtsigs ma/ /skrag byed gsod byed 'joms byed rnam rgyal gzhan las rgyal/ /rmugs byed rmongs byed rengs byed rdo rje phag mo ni/ /rnal 'byor chen mo 'dod pa'i dbang mo mkha' 'gror 'dud/ /huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ rkang brgyad do/ /oṃ he ru ka dpal ye shes che/ /rnal 'byor chen po thub chen po/ /mgon po chen po byed pa che/ /theg pa chen po shing rta che/ /gsung ba chen po shes rab che/ /dpa' bo chen po don chen mdzad/ /'dzin pa chen po nga rgyal che/ /rgyal po chen po che ba'i che/ /mthu chen bde ba chen po ste/ /rol mo chen po brten chen po/ /mtshon cha chen po drag po che/ /bzhad pa chen po 'jigs chen po/ /zhe sdang chen po 'dod chags che/ /gti mug chen po stobs chen po/ /mtshams rngam chen po sgra chen po/ /snyems pa chen po stobs chen po/ /sku gsum lam gsum cha byad can/ /'khor lo gsum dang srid gsum mchog

/dri ma gsum spangs dus gsum gnas/ /spyan gsum sum cu gsum dbang phyug /srid pa gnon pa srid rtse'i mchog /srid pa ldan zhing srid las 'das/ /srid pa dngos med srid snang ba/ / srid pa'i dgra yi gtso bo ste/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa rnal 'byor che/ /rnal 'byor ma yi rnal 'byor brtson/ /rnal 'byor las byung rnal 'byor shes/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor 'joms byed pa/ /dpa' bo rdo rje dbang phyug dgyes/ /rdo rje phreng bas rnal 'byor brgyan/ /rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ yang dag bsten/ /rdo rje chen po rdo rje phyag / rdo rje gar chen brtan pa ste/ /rdo rje glu ni sgra chen po/ /rdo rje pad+ma'i ting 'dzin bzhugs/ /rdo rje gdan ni dga' bas dga'/ /bde ba'i bzhed dgu thob pa ste/ /'od kyis skye bo skyod pa po/ /lus ngag yid kyis thams cad du/ khyed la gus pas bdag 'dud do/ /mkha' 'gro dra ba la phyag 'tshal/ /phyag 'tshal mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor la/ /stong pa'i ye shes phyag 'tshal bstod/ /stong pa'i thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zhes pa mtshan brgya dang*/ bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i 'jigs pa'i gzugs ldan pa/ khros pas 'jigs mdzad mtsho skyes sngon po'i sku mdog bzhin/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor steng bzhugs kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang ni/ /rdo rje bsnams shing oṃ oṃ yi ge dag pa yis/ / tshangs pa dang ni khyab 'jug drag po'i lha dag gi /mgo rnams bcad mdzad nas ni dbu la rnam brgyan pa/ /hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa ṭa ṭa'i yi ge 'khor ldan pa/ /mi yi seng ge zil mnan nas ni 'jigs mdzad pa/ /thugs rje chen pos sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i tshul bskyed pa/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥdapal mo'i nu mar rab tu mnan/ /bde bar gshegs pas dbu gtsug la ni rnam brgyan pa/ /lha rnams kun gyi dbu gtsug zhabs kyis mnan bzhugs pa/ /a la la yi sgra ni bgegs rnams skrag mdzad pa/ /cang te'u 'khrol zhing khyab 'jug drag po'i pags pa bsnams/

/ rdo rje lha mo rnams kyis 'khor lo sgyur mdzad pa/ /hu lu hu lu dz+riṃ dz+riṃ traṃ traṃ dzaṃ dzaṃ sgrogs/ /rgyu mas brgyus pa'i mgo bo'i phreng ba brgyan ldan pa/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i gzugs kyis 'jigs byed glur len ma/ /kruṃ kruṃ dang ni hu lu hu lus myos mdzad pa/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gros sku la rnam par brgyan pa yis/ /dur khrod du ni gar dang ha la ha la'i sgras/ /gnod sbyin rnams ni rengs shing skrag par mdzad pa des/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma yis glus ni rab bskul ba/ /sha dang khrag dang rgyu ma nang khrol gsol bar mdzad/ /haṃ haṃ a a'i sgras ni lha rnams gsal mdzad pa/ /thod pa klad pas bkang nas gsol phyir phyag na bsnams/ /ka ha ka ha'i bzhad sgras 'khor ba 'jigs mdzad pa/ /mi bzad dur khrod rnams kyi rus pa'i rgyan ldan pa/ /rdo rje ha har bzhad pas khams gsum brgyal mdzad pa/ /ha ha hi hi dza dza'i yi ges sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /ha ha bzhad pa ri bo'i rtse nas sgyel mdzad pa/ /rnal 'byor ma dang dpal rnams hri hri sgrog pas 'bod/ /mi yi seng ge rtse gsum gyis 'gugs sems can don mdzad pa/ /mche ba gtsigs pa'i zhal bzhi sku mdog sngon por ldan/ /bruṃ bruṃ sgrogs shing phyag rgya chen por skyed mdzad pa/ /rdo rje glog stong 'gyu ba'i ljags ni phyung nas kyang*/ /rdo rje dril bu mda' dang gzhu la kraṃ kraṃ sgrog /g.yon brkyang ba dang sbrul rnams kyi ni dbu rgyan zhes/ /bskal pa grangs med sems can don byed mi 'dor ba/ /ha na ha na phaṭa phaṭa sgrogs shing skrod mdzad pa/ /rnal 'byor stobs kyis rgyal ba'i mdzad pa rnams mdzad pa/ /dngos dang dngos med min zhing sgom dang rdo rje can/ /tsa ṭa tsa ṭa graṃ graṃ khaṃ khaṃ sgrogs mdzad pa/ /sangs rgyas sku gsung thugs kyi spros pa stong pa nyid/ /rol pa'i lta ba'i dri ma ma lus bral ba dang*/ /go lu go lu dzaṃ dzaṃ yaṃ yaṃ sgrogs pas zhi ba dang*/

/mkha' dang mnyam pa'i ting 'dzin bzhugs pa'i thugs mnga' ba/ /maṃ maṃ sgras ni bde ba chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /thugs rje chen pos rjes 'brail sems can mi gtong ba/ /brtan g.yo'i rang bzhin he ru ka dpal phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig ā li kā li sbyor ba ste/ /rigs lnga'i bde gshegs bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad du gsol/ /lha dang drang srong rnams ni phyag 'tshal mchod pa yin/ /he ru ka dpal gsang ba'i sku 'dzin der nges 'gyur/ /de nas grub chen dā ri ka pas mdzad pa'i rgyun bshags ni/ thog ma med dus 'khor ba nas/ /chags sogs rtogs pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /sdig bgyis mgon po'i spyan snga ru/ /ma lus so sor bshags par bgyi/ /rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu yi/ /nyer bsdus 'gro ba thams cad kyi/ /bsod nams tshogs ni ma lus la/ /rtag par bdag ni yi rang ngo*/ /rdo rje ye shes thugs chud nas/ /shing dbang drung na bzhugs gyur pa'i/ /'gro la nyer brtses thub dbang rnams/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol/ /rgyal ba'i mdzad pa rdzogs gyur te/ /mgon po dbyings su gshegs bzhed la/ /sems can sdug bsngal bral bar du/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bdag gsol 'debs/ /bdag ni thub dbang ma gyur bar/ /sangs rgyas la sogs chos rnams dang*/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs bcas/ /dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /rnal 'byor lam la gnas bgyis shing*/ /dam tshig thams cad skyang ba dang*/ /sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las/ /grol bar bdag gis sgrub pa bgyi/ /sten sogs dge ba de dag gis/ /rnam pa'i mchog rnams kun ldan pa'i/ /sangs rgyas nyid du bdag gyur nas/ /'gro ba yongs su sgrol byed shog /de nas rigs lnga'i sdom bzung dang*/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ zhes sogs dang*/ nangs par sngar langs sogs brjod par bya'o/ /rgyal ba sprul pa dang*/ bskal pa'i me 'bar ma gnyis 'gyur khyad yin rung*/

snga ma la 'gyur chad pa bag re snang bas/ phyi ma bzang ngo*/ /mtshan brgyad dang*/ bskal pa'i me 'bar ma dang*/ dā ri ka'i rgyun bshags rnams da lta'i dus na/ bde mchog smra ba khas 'che ba kun la'ang grags chung bas mi nub pa'i phyir 'dir smos te/ bstod pa de rnams rgyal ba'i bka' yin pas cho ga'i tshe gal che'o/ /da ni 'dir brjod pa bya ste/ oṃ a tha/ dpal ldan zab gsal dbyer med longs spyod rdzogs/ /dpe med bde rdzogs rab dga' mkha' mnyam pa/ /srid zhi kun gyi dpal mgon 'dren pa mchog/rdo rje slob dpon rdo rje 'chang la bstod/ /gang zhig bstod na yon tan kun thob cing*/ /bsten zhing mchod na dngos grub rnam gnyis thob/ /rnam pa sgom pas tha mal snang zhen 'gog /de la bdag gis bstod pa'i phreng ba dbul/ /'byung bzhi ri rab lhun po'i stengs/ /byang chub phyogs chos sum cu bdun/ /ye shes gzhal med khang par snang*/ /bde chen gnas kyi 'khor lo yi/ /sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte ba ru/ / rigs kun bdag po bcom ldan 'das/ /kun bzang khro bo he ru ka /'khor lo bde mchog la phyag 'tshal/ /gti mug spangs pa'i nyi mar rol/ /mthing ga chos nyid 'gyur med dngos/ /rnam thar bzhi yi zhal bzhi pa/ /thabs shes zhabs gnyis ldan la 'dud/ /rtsa zhal gnag cing g.yon dmar ba/ /rgyab ser g.yas dkar spyan gsum ldan/ /dus gsum mkhyen zhing phyag bcu gnyis/ /rten 'brel bcu gnyis 'gags la 'dud/ /bcu gnyis 'gyur ba med pa'i sku/ /dang po'i phyag gnyis rdo rje dang*/ /dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud/ /yang dag ting 'dzin la phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje ye shes lnga mnyam pa/ /dril bu shes rab pha rol phyin/ /zung 'jug phyag rgyar sbyor ba yi/ /he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnyis pas glang chen lpags rlon bsgyangs/ /cang te'u dgra sta rtse gsum dang*/ /rdo rje gri gug g.yas pa yi/ /lhag ma'i phyag gis 'dzin phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga

/rdo rje zhags pa thod khrag dang*/ /tshangs mgo gdong bzhi g.yon pa'i phyag /lhag ma bzhi yis 'dzin phyag 'tshal/ /rmongs pa dral ba'i glang pags gos/ /mchog dga'i sgra yis rgyal rnams bskul/ /sgo gsum dgra < stas > nyes spangs <rtse gsum gyis > srid gsum 'joms/ /rnam rtog <gri gug > gcod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dag < kha ṭ+wṃ > de bzhin du/ /ye shes kyis ni dngos kun <zhags pa > 'ching*/ /bde chen thugs rje'i bdag nyid <thod pa > can/ /chu bo < tshangs mgo gdong bzhi > bzhi rnams 'joms phyag 'tshal/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das brnyes pas/ /g.yon brkyang stabs kyis yang dag bzhugs/ /'jigasabyed dus mtshan yang dag mnan/ / rtag chad gzung 'dzin 'joms la 'dud/ /nor bu rna cha 'gur chu gdub/ /mi rus thal ba mchod phyir thogs/ /pha rol phyin drug rang bzhin gyi/ /phyag rgya drug ldan la phyag 'tshal/ /chos dbyings las byung rdo rje'i phreng*/ /ye shes thod skam lnga lngas brgyan/ /dge ba'i chos rnams yongs rdzogs pa/ /ral pa'i cod pan 'chang la 'dud/ /g.yon ngos zla phyed 'jigs med bde/ /don mdzad sna tshogs rdo rjes brgyan/ /lta ba thams cad nges 'byin pas/ /rnam par 'gyur ba'i zhal la 'dud/ /mche gtsigs bdud bzhi rnam par 'joms/ /gar gyi nyams dgur ldan pa yis/ /rigs lnga yum bzhi'i rang bzhin can/ /zhi lhag bde stong sbyor la 'dud/ /kun da'i rang bzhin thal bas byugs/ /sems byung yi ge lnga bcu'i bdag /khrag 'dzag mgo phreng stag lpags grol/ /skyon drug bcom la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de yi'i 'phang gnas 'khril sbyor ba/ /stong nyid ye shes skyed byed ma/ /chos kun don dam ro gcig pa/ /thabs shes gnyis su ston pa'i phyir/ /dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /rab khros spyan gsum g.yo mdzad ma/ /bcom ldan 'das ma la phyag 'tshal/ /dbyings las ye shes skyer 'jug pas/

/skra grol gcer mo sgrib pa spangs/ /yan lag bcu gnyis chos ston pa'i/ /dum bu'i 'og pag can la 'dud/ /phyag g.yon thod pa bdud bzhi'i khrag /rnam par gang ba yab la stob/ /spros kun gcod cing sdigs mdzad pa'i/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje 'dzin la 'dud/ /'khor ba spangs shing 'gro ba rnams/ /mi dmigs <khrag 'dzag3gt; shin tu rnam dag pa'i/ /ye shes snang ba <me ltar 'bar > la sbyor phyir/ khrag 'dzag me ltar brjid la 'dud/ /thabs shes 'bral med zung 'jug phyir/ / g.yon brkyang stabs kyis yab la 'khyud/ /phyag rgya lngas brgyan thod skam gyis/ /do shal 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnyis ka'ang spyi bo'i 'khor lo dang*/ /ska rags zhabs gdub g.yer kha'i phreng*/ /sor gdub la sogs nye ba yi/ /phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan la 'dud/ /snang ba lhag mthong bde chen yab/ /stong dang zhi gnas lha sku yum/ /zung 'jug mnyam par sbyor bar mdzad/ khrag 'thung yab yum la phyag 'tshal/ /mi shigs dpyid dag dpa' bo ste/ /rkyang ma ro ma kun 'dar ma/ /bdud 'bral lta ba'i gtum mo rnams/ /rnam dag rdo rje phag mor 'dud/ /rtsa dang <dza la tshogs la > lha mo rngul gyi khams/ /dhū tī gtso bo khu bar sdom/ /pad+ma'i <dza la pad+ma > bde mchog 'od gsal bar/ /dngos kun sdom mdzad gtso bor 'dud/ /shrī yig gnyis med ye shes te/ /he yig rgyu tshogs stong pa nyid/ /ru yig tshogs bral ka yig ni/ /gang du'ang mi gnas khyod phyag 'tshal/ /ngag gi yul <pa rā hi'i nges don yi ge lnga dang sbyar ba > 'das rang rig pa/ / rnam med rnam pa thams cad ston/ /shes dang shes bya gcig gyur sku/ /rdo rje phag mo de la 'dud/ /gser mdog pad+ma'i 'dab ma la/ /shar du chu rlung rgyu ba'i rtsa/ /sum bskor ma ni sbyangs pa'i sku/ /mkha' 'gro ma sngo la phyag 'tshal/ /byang du rlung gi rlung rgyu ba'i/ /'dod ma dag pa'i lā ma ljang*/ /me rlung khyim ma dag pa nub/ /dmar mo dum skyes ma la 'dud/

/sa rlung gtum mo dag pa lhor/ / gzugs can ma ni ser mo'i sku/ /lus tshor chos dang sems dran pa/ /nye bar bzhag pa bzhi la 'dud/ /thams cad skra grol g.yas brkyang stabs/ /spyan gsum phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan/ /mgo phraing rgyal ba'i cod pan can/ /bha ga nu ma rgyas la 'dud/ /phyag g.yas gri gug g.yon pa na/ /glang po ce spyang mi ba glang*/ /sgron ma bdud rtsis rnam gang ba'i/ /thod pa bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgrib pa thams cad gtan spangs shing*/ /yon tan kun gyis rnam brgyan pa/ /de bzhin gshegs ma thams cad la/ /rtag tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtshams su zla ba'i gdan gyi steng/ /mer rdul bden bral khu ba dang*/ /rlung du sha chen dbang ldan du/ /sman dang dris gang snod rnams ni/ /bdud rtsi lnga 'bab mchod pa'i rtsa/ /phyogs kyi rtsa yi rigs byung ba/ /rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin nyid/ /thabs kyi ngo bo la phyag 'tshal/ /'dab brgyad sna tshogs pad+ma ni/ /phyi rol ra ba ka ba thog /gri gug mtshan mas rnam par brgyan/ /nye ba'i mthung spyod la phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje gdung gis mdzes par phub/ /rtsigs pa pha gu bre phul dang*/ /mda' yab rgyan ldan dbus phyur bu/ /rdo rje nor bus spras la 'dud/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs rnams la/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi ye shes chai/ /rab dga'i dri med sa yi tshul/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor mar phyag 'tshal/ /shar rtsibs pu lir mi phyed ma/ /so sen 'bab pa rnam par dag /'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul rkang pa'i dngos/ /thod dum rab gtum mar phyag 'tshal/ /byang rtsibs drwa 'dzin phra gzugs ma/ /skra spu dag pa rdzu 'phrul rkang*/ /brtson 'grus ma hā kaṃ ka la/ /gtum mig mar bcas la phyag 'tshal/ /nub rtsibs o ḍi rtse ba ma/ /pags pa dri ma rnam dag par/ /dpyod pa'i ngo bo keng rus dang*/ /'od ldan ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lho rtsibs g.yon ma arbu dar/ /sha ni rnam dag sems kyi ni/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa'i rang bzhin

can/ /mche gtsigs sna chen mar phyag 'tshal/ /shar lho thung ngu ba mchog sbyin/ /rgyus pa 'bab pa rnam dag pa/ /dad pa'i dbang po lha yi dgra/ /brtan pa'i blo mar bcas la 'dud/ /lho nub dga' dbang rus sbal skyes/ /rus pa 'bab pa rnam dag pa/ /brtson 'grus dbang po 'od dpag med/ /mi'u thung mar bcas la phyag 'tshal/ /nub byang sgom ma lha mo'i mkhar//mkhal ma mchin pa rnam dag pa/ /dran pa'i dbang po rdo rje 'od//laṅka'i dbangaphyug mar bcas 'dud/ /byang shar dbang ma ma lā bar/ /snying 'bab pa ni rnam dag pa/ /ting 'dzin dbang po rdo rje'i sku/ /shing grib mar bcas la phyag 'tshal/ /'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa/ /phyi rol ra ba ka ba thog /rdo rje'i mtshan mas rnam par brgyan/ /gnas dang nye gnas la phyag 'tshal/ /gsung gi 'khor lo'i rtsibs rnams la/ /bcom ldan ye shes 'od byed dang*/ /'od 'phro sbyang dka' mngon gyur tshul/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma phyag 'tshal/ /shar phyogs 'dod gzugs skyon ldan ma/ /mig gnyis 'bab pa rnam dag pa/ /shes rab dbang po myu gu can/ /sa srungs mar bcas la phyag 'tshal/ /byang phyogs o trer 'jug ma ni/ /mkhris pa 'bab pa rnam dag pa/ /dad stobs rdo rje ral pa can/ /'jigs byed chen mor bcas la 'dud/ /nub phyogs ma mo dge mtshan gsum/ /glo ba 'bab pa rnam dag pa/ /brtson 'grus stobs ni dpa' bo che/ /rlung shugs can mar bcas la 'dud/ /lho phyogs mtshan mo ko sa lar/ /rgyu ma 'bab pa rnam dag pa/ /dran pa'i stobs ni hūṃ mdzad de/ /chang 'thung mar bcas la phyag 'tshal/ /mer ni bsil sbyin ka ling ka /gnye ma 'bab pa rnam dag pa/ /ting nge 'dzin stobs rab bzang ni/ /sngo sangs lha mor bcas la 'dud/ /bden bral lam+pa tsha ba ma/ /lto ba 'bab pa rnam dag pa/ /shes rab stobs ni rdo rje bzang*/ /shin tu bzang mor bcas la 'dud/ /rlung mtshams gzhom ma kañtsi nas/ /bshang ba 'bab pa rnam dag pa/ /ting 'dzin yan lag 'jigs byed

che/ /rta rna mar bcas la phyag 'tshal/ /dbang ldan rangs ma hi ma la/ /mtshams kyi mtha' 'bab rnam dag pa/ /brtson 'grus yan lag mig mi bzang*/ /bya gdong mar bcas la phyag 'tshal/ /'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ /phyir rol ra ba ka ba thog/pad+mas mtshan pa zhing nye zhing*/ /tshan do nye bar bcas la 'dud/ /sku yi 'khor lo'i rtsibs rnams la/ /bcom ldan ye shes ring song dang*/ /mi g.yo legs blo chos sprin tshul/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor mar phyag 'tshal/ /dbang por gzugs can yi dwags grong*/ /bad kan 'bab pa rnam dag pa/ /dga' ba yan lag stobs po che/ /'khor lo'i shugs can mar bcas 'dud/ /nor du spyi ma khyim gyi lha/ /snag ni 'bab pa rnam dag pa/ /shin sbyangs rin chen rdo rje ni/ /dum skyes mar bcas la phyag 'tshal/ /chur ni rgyu sbyin so sor rāṣ+ta/ khrag rnams 'bab pa rnam dag pa/ /rnam 'byed yan lag rta mgrin rgyal/ /chang 'tshong mar bcas la phyag 'tshal/ /gshin rjer gser gling sbyor phral ma/ /rdul 'bab pa ni rnam dag pa/ /dran pa yan lag mkha' snying po/ /'khor lo'i go cha mar bcas 'dud/ /sreg zar sdug gu na ga ra/ /tshil bu 'bab pa rnam dag pa/ /btang snyoms yan lag he ru ka /shin tu dpa' mor bcas la 'dud/ /srin por sin+dhu grub ma ni/ /mchi ma 'bab pa rnam dag pa/ /yang dag lta ba gar dbang phyug/stobs chen mar bcas la phyag 'tshal/ /rlung du 'tshed ma ma ru'i yul/ /mchil ma 'bab pa rnam dag pa/ /yang dag rtog pa rnam snang mdzad/ /'khor los sgyur mar bcas la 'dud/ /'byung por yid bzangs ku lu ta/ /snabs 'bab pa ni rnam dag pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' yang dag dag /brtson 'grus chen mor bcas la 'dud/ /'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ /phyi rol ra ba ka ba thog/'khor los mtshan pa 'du nye 'du/ /dur khrod nye bar bcas la 'dud/ /thugs 'khor pa rnams bung ba'i mdog /gsung 'khor pa rnams rab tu dmar/ /sku 'khor pa rnams ku mud bzhin/

/rigs gsum lha rnams la phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin mchog /mkha' spyod sa steng sa 'og ste/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro kun 'dus pa'i/ /rdo rje'i pho nya la phyag 'tshal/ /thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /rdo rje dril bus yum la 'khyud/ /yum rnams gri gug thod pa 'dzin/ khyad par gzhan ni bcom ldan 'das/ /yab yum ji lta ba nyid de/ /dbus kyi thog phubs las gzhan pa'i/ /pha gu la sogs dbus ma bzhin/ /steng thog rim par phubs la 'dud/ /mos spyod sa dang mthung spyod dngos/ /dam tshig 'khor lo'i lha snam ni/ /phyogs mdog dbus su stegs bu sngo/ /'khor lo gsum gyi gzhi la 'dud/ /yang dag las mtha' gzhan mthu rtse/ /rnam dag shar sgor khwa gdong sngo/ /yang dag 'tsho ba mthu skyaid ma/ /byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ni ljang*/ /ro yi rtse mo nub kyi sgor/ /yang dag rtsol ba khyi gdong dmar/ /lhor sgor ro lus ma rnam dag /yang dag dran pa phag gdong ser/ /nam mkha' ma dag shar lho'i grwar/ gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo zhing*/ /g.yon ser dge ba'i chos skyed pa/ /lho nub chang sbyin ma dag pa/ /gshin rje pho nya ma g.yas ser/ g.yon dmar dge ba'i chos srung ba'o/ /rul ma dag pa nub byang grwar/ gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar/ /g.yon ljang mi dge mi skyed pa'o/ /byang shar gtogs ma rnam dag pa/ /gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon/ /sngo ba mi dge skye spong ba'o/ /de ltar sgo mtshams ma mo brgyad/ /yum bzhi ji lta ba nyid las/ /rab khros g.yon brkyang stabs kyis bzhugs/ /stag lpags grol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbang po nor bdag chu gshin rje/ /me srin rlung dang dbang ldan dang*/ /tshangs pa dang ni thags bzang ris/ /so so'i bgegs rnams 'joms la 'dud/ /'khor rnams ro gdan nyi mar gnas/ /kun kyang dpral par rdo rje'i 'phreng*/ /me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs/ /lang tsho rgyas pa la phyag 'tshal/ /chos 'khor lte bar rtsa bzhi dang*/

/dbyings dang phag mo zhal sbyor ba/ /chos 'khor rtsa brgyad rtsa ba'i rlung*/ /nang gi bde chen 'khor lor 'dud/ /spyi bo spyi gtsug rna g.yas ltag /rna g.yon smin mtshams mig phrag pa/ /mchan khung nu ma lte ba sna/ kha mgrin snying ga 'bras bu dang*/ /gsang ba bshang lam brla rje ngar/ /rkang sor bol gong mthe bong dang*/ /pus mo rnams te nyi shu bzhi/ /nang gi 'khor lo gsum la 'dud/ /chos 'khor phyi'i rtsa ba brgyad po/ /bu ga brgyad du son pa yi/ /dbang yul rnam par shes skyed pa/ /nang gi dam tshig 'khor lor 'dud/ /rtsa rlung ma mo bcu gnyis bdag /dkar dmar ro mnyam rlung bcas thugs/ /rngul ni gsung dang khu ba sku/ /nang gi dpa' po lha mor 'dud/ /gru bzhi dkyil 'khor bden pa bzhi/ /zur bzhi mnyam pa tshad med bzhi/ /sgo bzhi rnam par thal ba bzhi/ /rta babs bsdus dngos bzhi la 'dud/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ kha khyer mchod pa'i lha mo ni/ /mchod pa'i sprin rnams spro dang bcas/ /ye shes gzhal yas khang la bstod/ kha sogs bug brgyad dur khrod brgyad/ /phyogs skyong zhing skyong shing dang sprin/ /ri dang mchod rten me dang chu/ /grub pa brgyad la sogs par 'dud/ /gtum drag tshang tshing 'bar ba 'khrigs/ /'jigs byed thod pa ha har dgod/ /dpal nags 'jigs mun ca co can/ /dur khrod gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i bde ye shes/ /gcig nyid rab 'byams dkyil 'khor du/ /rnam par sprul la sgo gsum mo/ /dngos po kun dang bcas pas 'dud/ /bla ma dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon/ /dkyil 'khor dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams/ /sras bcas gsang dang rab gsang dang*/ /gsang chen bla med mchod pas mchod/ /dngos bshams yid kyis sprul pa dang*/ /sngags dang phyag rgya'i mthu stobs las/ /mchod sprin rgya mtsho dpag yas sprul/ /zhum pa med pa'i sems kyis dbul/ /mchod yon zhabs bsil zhal bsil dang*/

/mthor 'thung me tog spos mar me/ /dri dang zhal zas rol mo'i sgras/ /bla ma lha yi dkyil 'khor mchod/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg mchog dang*/ /chos te phyi yi 'dod yon drug /nang gi rig ma'i 'dod yon lnga/ /yid byung bde bar bcas pas mchod/ khyad par dngos grub thob pa'i phyir/ /nyer spyod zhun chen mar me dang*/ /sha chen dam tshig snang gsal sogs/ /brgya phrag du mar spel bas mchod/ /rig pa'i lha mo bcu drug dang*/ /sgeg mo la sogs lha mo brgyad/ /bde mchog ma sogs nyi shu ste/ /bde sbyin lha mo rnams kyis mchod/ /'khor lo glang po nor bu rta/ /bud med khyim bdag skyes pa ste/ /rgyal srid rin chen sna bdun gyis/ /stong gsum gang bar byas te 'bul/ /ral gri khang pa pags pa tshal/ /mal cha gos dang mchil lham mchog /pad dmar dbang sngon baiḍūr+ya/ /markata rdo rje mu tig dang*/ /byu ru rin chen dman par bcas/ /zla shel la sogs nor bu'i ri/ khrus kyi rdzing bu lha rdzas gos/ /rigs lnga'i gtan dang bzhon pa dang*/ /phyag mtshan so so'i dam tshig dang*/ /ma rmos lo thog 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /gter gyi bum pa dpag bsam shing*/ /zhing rnams gang bar byas te dbul/ khri pad nyi zla glo gdan lnga/ /phyag rgya rnam pa drug gis brgyan/ /byang chub yan lag me tog bdun/ /bkra shis lha mo brgyad rnams 'bul/ /rgyal mtshan dmar dang de bzhin ser/ /dkar dang gnag dang ser skya dang*/ /de bzhin gos ni sna tshogs dang*/ /me tog phreng ba du ma dang*/ /bla re dag dang dar dpyangs pa'i/ /mda' dang yol bas shin tu mdzes/ /bza' bca' btung ba dpag med dang*/ /bum pa dgu yis mchod par bya/ khyad par bla ma mchod pa'i phyir/ /dril bu sgra can dpyangs pa dang*/ /me tog spos rnams kyis brgyan zhing*/ /dga' ba'i rnga chen brdung pas mchod/ /gser ni brgya stong dbul ba dang*/ /rin chen rnam pa sna tshogs dang*/ /ras ni zung gyur brgya nyid dang*/

/glang po rta dang yul 'khor dang*/ /rna rgyan dang ni gdu bu dang*/ /mgul rgyan sor gdub dam pa dang*/ /gser las byas pa'i mchod phyir thogs/ /chung ma bzang dang bu mo nyid/ /bran pho bran mo sring mo rnams/ /phyag 'tshal nas ni dbul bar bya/ /lus ngag yid gsum gus bcas pas/ /dus gsum dge ba longs spyod dang*/ /deng nas brtsams te bran du ni/ /bdag nyid dngos po kun gyis 'bul/ /gzhan yang thabs shes sbyor las byung*/ /zla ba me tog dam pa ni/ /rab tu myangs pas bde ba thob/ /nang gi mchod pas mchod par bgyi/ /dngos grub dam tshig bdud rtsi lnga/ /rigs lnga'i dam tshig sgron ma lnga/ /bde ba'i rgyu mchog myos byed lnga/ /bla ma dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ /lha mo rdo rje gsum gyi rigs/ /pad ma can sogs rigs bzhi dang*/ /lhan skyes gnas skyes rigs skyes ma/ /mthar skyes sbyangs las thob pa dang*/ /gar ma chos ma rdo rje ma/ /gdol ma de bzhin bram ze mo/ /rigs drug las byung phyag rgya mchog/gzugs can ma sogs rigs bdun dang*/ khyad par lā ma'i rigs bud med/ /ma dang sring mo bu mo dang*/ /chung ma pho nya mo rnam bzhi/ / gzhan yang rigs ma brgyad po dang*/ /sum cu rtsa drug rigs brgya sogs/ /phul bas thabs shes mnyam par sbyar/ /ye shes gsum po gsal bar mtshon/ /dam pa'i bde bas mnyes par bgyi/ /yul lnga'i dbye ba rnam gsum las/ /snang ba gsum dang rang bzhin rnams/ /'od gsal bar ni nyer 'gro ba/ /gsang ba'i mchod pas mchod par bgyi/ /rdo rje nyi ma'i me tog gsol/ /gtum mo 'bar ba'i bdug pas bdug /mi shigs sngags kyi sgron me 'bar/ /zla bas lus kun khyab pa'i dri/ /stong nyid rnam pa'i zhal zas dang*/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bur rtogs/ /grag stong sgra dbyangs thams cad pa/ /sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor snyan grags dri/ /bde chen ro yi tshim pa dang*/ zung 'jug reg bya'i bde mchog gis/

/bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kun/ /bla na med pas mchod par bgyi/ khyad par nang gi bdag nyid kyi/ /sbrang rtsi mtshal dang ga bur bcas/ / tsan dan dmar po sbyar ba ni/ /rdo rje kun mtshan mtshan ma 'dzin/ /thabs shes sbom po mtha' stag sbyar/ /zhi ba'i btung ba bzhin myangs pas/ /rang rdzas thig les sangs rgyas dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mchod/ /mdor na 'jig rten khams kun gyi/ /mchod pa thams cad dbul bar bgyi/ /'khor ba thog med nas bzung ste/ /da lta'i bar du bdag cag gi /dug gsum gyis ni kun blang ste/ /lus ngag yid kyi nyes spyod gang*/ /bgyis dang bgyis du rtsal ba dang*/ /yi rang bsngags pa brjod pa sogs/ /thams cad da ltar so sor bshags/ /mi shes ma gus bag med pas/ /rang bzhin kha na ma tho dang*/ /sdom gsum bcas 'gal ci mchis dang*/ khyad par bla ma'i thugs dkrugs dang*/ /bde gshegs bka' 'das spun la khros/ /byams pa spangs dang byang sems btang*/ /grub mtha' smod dang ma smin la/ /gsang ba sbyin dang phung po smod/ /dag pa'i chos la the tshom dang*/ /gdug la byams dang ming sogs bral/ /de la gzhan du rtog pa dang*/ /dad ldan bslu dang tshogs 'khor du/ /dam tshig spong dang bu med smod/ /phas pham pa ni bcu bzhi dang*/ /ma sbyangs rig ma bsten la dga'/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lor rtsod pa dang*/ /gsang ba'i chos ni ston pa dang*/ /dad ldan rnams la chos gzhan ston/ /nyan thos nang du zhag bdun gnas/ /skal min gsang ba ston pa dang*/ /mi mkhas pa la phyag rgya ston/ /ma bsnyen dkyil 'khor las la 'jug/de sogs yan lag ltung ba dang*/ sbom po'i ltung ba gang bgyis dang*/ /'chang dang bsten bya ma brten dang*/ /sgrub pa'i dam tshig ma sgrubs dang*/ /rigs lnga'i dam tshig de bzhin du/ /dam tshig brgya las 'das pa sogs/ /rgyud sde bzhi las gang gsungs pa'i/ /nyes pa thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags rnams dang*/

/so so'i skye bos gang bgyis pa/ /'khor 'das dus gsum byung ba yi/ /dge ba kun la yi rang ngo*/ /rgyal gsung 'chad pa mi mnga' yang*/ /'gro ba thar par 'dren pa'i slad/ bla med chos 'khor rgyun mi chad/ /da lta nyid du bskor du gsol/ / rang bzhin skye 'jig mi mnga' yang*/ /skal dman sems can bsgral ba'i phyir/ /'khor ba ji srid sprul pa'i sku/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol/ /dbang thob slob dpon sangs rgyas mchog /thabs shes dbyer med rdo rje'i chos/ /rdo rje theg zhugs dge 'dun la/ /byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi/ /bla ma 'dres pa sras bcas la/ /kun nas kun tu bdag nyid 'bul/ /deng nas nam mkha' gnas kyi bar/ khyed kyi 'bangs su bzung du gsol/ /dus gsum dge ba thams cad kyang*/ /sems can byang chub rgyur bsngo'o/ /bla med byang chub gnas bya'i phyir/ /rgyal ba kun gyi spyan snga ru/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba ji lta bar/ /skal ldan byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /byang chub sems ni skyed pa ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis sems bskyed do/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*/ /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*/ /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /de bzhin brtan por gzung bar bgyi/ /ji ltar phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba yis/ /sngon gyi bde gshegs grangs med la/ /thugs bskyed dam tshig dpag med dag /'tshang rgya'i bar du mi gtong ltar/ /bdag gi deng nas byang chub bar/ /lus srog ltos pa med par yang*/ /bslab 'di mgon bzhin srung la gnas/ /ye shes thugs kyis dgongs su gsol/ /bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin spangs nas/ /stong nyid snying rje sgom pa dang*/ /byams dang snying rje dga' ba dang*/ /btang snyoms rnams la gnas par bgyi/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus/ /bsam gtan shes rab pha rol phyin/ /deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /bdag gis 'bad pas bslab par bgyi/ /dran pa nyer bzhag yang dag spong*/

/rdzu 'phrul rkang pa rnam bzhi dang*/ /dbang po lnga dang stobs rnams lnga/ /byang chub yan lag rnam pa bdun/ /'phags lam brgyad rnams rim gyis bskyed/ /sbyin dang snyan par smra ba dang*/ /don spyod pa dang don mthun pa/ /bsdu ba'i dngos po rnam bzhi yis/ /'gro ba'i don chen sgrub par bgyi/ / sngags rgyud sbyor ba la mkhas shing*/ /rtag tu mi dge bcu spangs nas/ /stong dang bde ba snying rje che/ /rim pa gnyis po sgom par bgyi/ /rgod dang 'gyod dang gnyid rmugs pa/ /'dod la 'dun dang the tshom ste/ /sgrib pa lnga po spang bar bgyi/ /le lo brjed nges bying rgod dang*/ /'du mi byed dang 'du byed spang*/ /dad 'dun brtson 'grus shin tu sbyangs/ /dran rtogs 'du byed rnal gnas pas/ /zhi lhag ting 'dzin sgom par bgyi/ /rnam rtog ye shes lngar gyur pa/ /rtag tu bsten zhing spyad par bgyi/ /rnam snang rigs la sangs rgyas dang*/ /chos dang dge 'dun skyabs su bgyi/ /mi bskyod rigs la dam tshig gsum/ /rdo rje slob dpon gus pas bsten/ /chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs byams/ /rin chen rigs la sbyin par bgyi/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg gsum chos/ /pad+ma'i rigs la bzung bar bgyi/ /las kyi rigs la sdom pa kun/ /bzung zhing mchod pa thams cad bgyi/ /srog gcod 'phrog dang log g.yem rdzun/ /chang 'thung pa yang spang bar bya/ /dam pa bsten zhing mchod par bgyi/ theg dman mi 'dod 'gro mi spangs/ /'khor ba mi spangs myang 'das la/ /mi dga' mtha' la gnas mi bgyid/ /bdag gis sems can thams cad la/ /brnyas pa yang ni mi bgyi ste/ /phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon cha dang*/ /mtshan ma 'god par mi bgyid do/ / sems nyid ye shes rdo rje dang*/ /brjod bral mkha' mnyam dril bu dang*/ /sgyu 'phrul zung 'jug phyag rgya ste/ /rdo rje gsum la bslab par bgyi/ /nyi shu rtsa gnyis srungs pa dang*/ /tshes bcu dag la mchod par bgyi/

/lag pa'i mchod pas yang dag mchod/ /bu med thams cad mthong ba na/ /g.yon nas bskor zhing gsol gsum gdab/ /bdag bu khyod ma byang chub kyi/ /yan lag 'o mas skyongs zhes gsol/ /g.yon pa'i kun spyod rtag tu bslab/ /sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bza' bas/ /rdo rje rnam bzhi mchod par bgyi/ /las dang dam tshig chos phyag chen/ /'dzag med bde ba'i rgyu ru bsten/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma kun la/ / gus pas bsnyen bkur mchod par bya/ /brda sogs dam tshig skyang bar bgyi/ khyad par rnal 'byor rgyud kun tu/ /brnyes dka'i dam tshig brgyad po srung*/ / g.yon pa'i kun spyod de bzhin du/ /'dod pas phyag rgya sgrod pa spang*/ /rang gzhan mnyam nyid lta ba dang*/ /theg pa gzhan dag spang bar bgyi/ /de nyid ldan pas dus rtag tu/ /phyag rgya bsten dang de mi 'bral/ /kun da mi g.yo mi ltung dang*/ /bha ga'i bcud len rab tu bza'/ /rlung sems stong par bsad bya zhing*/ /rten 'brel 'gro ba sgrol ba'i rdzun/ /btsun mo khu ba ma byin len/ /rang snang stong sems gzhan bud med/ /dgongs te gsungs pa rnam bzhi po/ /rigs sngags 'chang kun mi 'da' ltar/ /deng nas bla med byang chub bar/ /bdag gis tshul bzhin bsrung bar bgyi/ /nyin mtshan lan gsum gnas dang ldang*/ /'jug dang rdzogs dang byin rlabs dbang*/ /ting 'dzin mchod pa nyer bsdu sgom/ /yul snang bde chen drang bar bgyi/ /legs gnas zla ba 'dus pa yi/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo rab tu spyod/ /dkyil 'khor ting 'dzin phyag rgya bzlas/ /stang stabs 'dug stangs sbyin sreg mchod/ /las sbyor slar bsdu phyi yi bcu/ /phyir zlog gnyis dang gsang dbang dang*/ /shes rab ye shes kha sbyor 'byed/ /gtor ma rdor zlas drag shul sgrub/ /rab gnas dkyil 'khor sgrub pa ste/ /gsang ba'i de nyid bcu sgrub bo/ /dpa' bo'i dbang phyug mi bri zhing*/ /gang gi thad du'ang mi gdon no/ /g.yon pa'i kun spyod rab tu sba/

/he ru ka dpal rnal 'byor pa/ /slob dpon rnal 'byor ma nyid yin/ /tsā ru yis ni rtag tu mchod/ /slob dpon mthong bas dga' gyur te/ /sgrub pos rtsa sngags mchog lan bdun/ /hūṃ bcas 'bad de phyag byas nas/ /sangs rgyas la sogs mchod par bgyi/ /rdo rje theg pa gang gsungs pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa thams cad srung*/ /lam rnams thams cad bsten par bgyi/ /'di las gzhan du mi bgyid do/ /de ltar ting 'dzin sgoms pa dang*/ /phyag 'tshal mchod dang sdig bshags dang*/ /yi rang bskul zhing gsol btab dang*/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dam tshig bzung*/ / lam bsten pa yi dge ba dang*/ /gzhan yang dus gsum dge ba rnams/ /ma lus gcig tu sdoms pa'i mthus/ /dpag yas sems can ma lus pa/ /rdo rje theg pa'i snod gyur te/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas myur thob shog /thun mong lam gyi rgyud sbyangs pa'i/ /tshe 'di dang ni 'khor ba la/ /glog dang me yi 'obs ltar rtogs/ /dge sdig blang dor tshul bzhin spyad/ /skye bo kun gyi khur khyer nas/ / byang chub sems mchog bskyed par shog /mtha' bral lta ba rtogs pa dang*/ /zhi gnas lhag mthong zung 'jug sgom/ /chos spyod bcu la spyod pa dang*/ /phyin bcu nyams su len par shog /dkyil 'khor gsum du legs par zhugs/ /dbang bzhis rgyud ni smin byas pas/ /tha mal snang zhen spros pa'i gdangs/ /kun rtogs gnyis snang 'khrud par shog /dam tshig dang ni sdom pa dang*/ /brtul zhugs rnams ni lam bzang gi /rtsa ba shes nas 'bad pa yis/ /srog bzhin skyong bas srung bar shog /bsnyen pa la sogs yan lag bzhi/ /ting 'dzin rnam gsum rnal 'byor dang*/ /rjes dang shin tu rnal 'byor dang*/ /rnal 'byor chen po sgom par shog /sngon 'gro tshogs bsags mthun rkyen sgrub/ /stong pas 'chi ba'i srid pa sbyangs/ /nā das bar do sbyong ba yi/ /ting 'dzin zab mo sgom par shog /srung ba'i 'khor los bdud bcom zhing*/

/'byung bzhi lhun po gzhal yas khang*/ /gang du 'tshang rgya'i gnas nges pas/ /ma dag zhing rnams sbyong bar shog /'byung ba'i gnas bzhi kun 'dar rtsa/ /rtsa yi 'khor lor byin rlabs pas/ /gnas der bde chen 'dren pa dang*/ /rlung thim smin par byed par shog /de rgyu zla nyi sa bon sogs/ /mngon byang lnga las rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags can rnams gdul ba'i phyir/ /thugs rjes snyoms 'jug sgom par shog /nā da zhugs pas rab tu zhu/ /skul bas yig 'bru'i rim pas rdzogs/ / 'bras bu'i bde mchog skye srid sbyong*/ /sprul sku'i ring lam sgom par shog / thig le bzhi dang bcu gnyis 'pho/ /yid bzang dhū tī skye mched sogs/ /sbyong byed zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis/ /zhabs gnyis go cha gsum bsgom shog /ye shes sems dpa' nges tshig ldan/ /dbang bskur rdzogs sangs rgyas pa dang*/ /ma rig 'du byed rnam shes rnams/ /nā da'i gzugs kyis sbyong bar shog /mi gzugs skye mched 'bras bu yis/ /rdo rje 'dzin pas sbyong ba dang*/ /skye mched reg sogs go cha dang*/ /ye shes bzhugs pas sbyong bar shog /de nas dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang*/ /las rgyal mchog dang nye bsdu'i bar/ /sgoms pas rga shi'i bar sbyong zhing*/ /rig pa rnam bzhi thob par shog khyad par gtum mos zhu ba'i bde/ /lhan skyes dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gis/ /ye shes rim pa'i rjes dran mchog /bcu drug smin pa'i lam sgom shog /phra thig gtum mo'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /bde stong lha sku thob pa dang*/ /rlung rnams dhū tīr thim byed pas/ /dran pa gcig pa mngon gyur shog /bde stong lhar snang nga rgyal gyis/ /tha mal snang zhen zlog pa dang*/ /dag snang rab 'byams yan lag bdun/ /phra rags rim pas mngon 'gyur shog khyad par thun mong ma yin pa/ /lus kyi dkyil 'khor sgom par shog /snying gar dpa' bo yab yum gyis/ /thig le'i 'du 'phrod rdzogs par shog

/yum bzhi snying gar bkod pa yis/ /rtsa ba'i rlung rnams 'dur bar shog /mchod pa'i rtsa rnams byin rlabs pas/ khams bzhi dag par byed pa shog /bu ga'i rtsa la ma mo brgyad/ /bkod pas yan lag rlung 'du zhing*/ /dbang po drug gi mngon shes sogs/ /bde bas 'thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /nye bzhi'i rtsa la bkod pa'i lhas/ /rlung dang thig le'i 'pho ba 'gog /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i smin byed mchog /gdod ma'i dkyil 'khor sgom par shog /lhag mthong zhi gnas mchog grub nas/ /spyod pa rnam pa gsum spyad pas/ /las dang dngos grub kun grub nas/ /'gro ba'i don chen sgrub par shog /las chen bcu gnyis thogs med grub/ /grub pa'i dngos grub rnam brgyad thob/ /'dod gzugs rigs pa 'dzin pa mchog /yon tan brgyad ldan thob par shog /des kyang chog par mi 'dzin par/ /bla med byang chub sgrub pa'i phyir/ /bya ba kun la ltos med par/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa sgom par shog /so sor bsdud dang bsam gtan dang*/ /srog rtsol 'dzin pa de bzhin du/ /rjes su dran dang ting nge 'dzin/ /yan lag drug po sgom par shog/rang gi sku ni sgyu ma mnyam/ /rdo rje'i zlas dang mtshan nyid do/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems kyi gter/ /lhag ma zung 'jug sgom par shog /rigs drug rigs bdun rigs brgyad dang*/ /lā ma'i rigs lnga khyad par gyi/ /pho nya brda sogs mtshan nyid shes/ /rjes su chags pas rab mchod shog /gti mug chen po gti mug dag /de bzhin nga rgyal ser sna dang*/ /'dod chags phrag dog zhe sdang che/ /ye shes rnam lnga grub gyur cig /'gro ba kun gyi nyer 'tsho mchog /rin chen bum pa dpag bsam shing*/ ji lta de bzhin bdag gi ni/ /lus ngag yid gsum de ltar shog /dbang dang gzungs dang rnam par thar/ /so sor rig sogs thob par shog /a ba dhū tīr thig le sogs/ /sgoms pas dbu mar rlung bsdus nas/ /'khor lo rnams kyi lte ba ru/

/zhugs gnas thim gsum byed par shog /phyag rgya'i srog rtsol bsgoms pa las/ /bde chen myur du 'dren 'gyur te/ /las kyi phyag rgya'i mchog gyur pa/ /gnas gsum pho nyar sbyor bar shog /sgoms pa'i yid kyi phyag rgya dang*/ /stong pas bde chen skyed pa dang*/ /yid ni nang chud 'dod pa'i don/ /dngos grub phyag chen la 'khyud shog/bde stong dbyer med lhan cig skyes/ /rang bzhin snang ba rim pas thim/ rang bzhin dag pa mngon du gyur/ /stong phyogs rdzogs rim mngon gyur shog /'od gsal nyid las ma g.yos par/ /gzugs sku'i snang ba tshad med pa/ /dbyer med zung 'jug yan lag bdun/ /snang phyogs rdzogs rim thob par shog /'khor lo bzhi po rnam sgom pas/ /rlung rnams rim gyis las rung ste/ /'khor lo'i yi ge gsal bar snang*/ /rgyud kyi rim pa mngon gyur shog/rlung gnyis thim pas gtum mo 'bar/ /bde gshegs bdud rtsis byin rlabs pas/ /lte bar dkar dmar 'dres las thob/ /lhan skyes sngags rim thob par shog/yas brtan dga' ba bcu drug gis/ /nor bur byang sems bde ba thob/ /mas brtan rjes dran bcu drug gis/ /ye shes rim pa mngon gyur shog /phra rags rlung dang thig le'i 'gros/ /gnyis snang sems gsum dbu mar thim/ /snang stong bde chen lhan cig skyes/ /gsang ba'i rim pa mchog thob shog /dga' ba bzhi yi rang bzhin gsal/ /thig le bzhi po mchog sgom pas/ /rim pa bzhi po mthar phyin nas/ /sgrib pa bzhi po byang bar shog /bden gnyis zung 'jug rnal 'byor gsum/ /spyod pa gsum gyis mthar phyung bas/ /gang zag gsum du rab rdzogs nas/ /sku gsum mngon du 'gyur bar shog /sum cu bdun pa'i rtsa khams thim/ /bcu gnyis sa rnams mngon du gyur/ /mos spyod sa rnams yongs rdzogs nas/ /mthong lam ye shes mngon gyur shog /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i zhing rnams bsgrod/ /pho nya mchog dang yang dag 'dus/

/zung 'jug bde chen gong nas gong*/ /'phel bas sa rnams thob par shog /bde ba'i gnyis snang spang pa yi/ /kun 'dar spyod pa dam pa dang*/ /dri mas ma gos kun bzang spyod/ /spyad pas dngos grub thob par shog /zil gnon 'jigs spangs gzhan gyi don/ / sgrub byed phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi/ /spyod pa de kun rnam gsum gyis/ /gong ma'i lam dang sa thob shog /ting 'dzin cho ga'i dbye ba yis/ /spros bcas spros med spyod pa dang*/ /shin tu spros med spyod pa yis/ /rim bzhin mtha' ru phyin par shog/gzhan yang lto ba'i sprin sgra la/ /sems bzung rlung gnyis thim las 'bar/ /haṃ yig zhu bas dga' bzhi thob/ /sdud byed ting 'dzin sgom par shog /rdo rjai gsum gyi yig 'bru'i gdangs/ /dhū tīr yang yang bsgrags pa las/ /dga' ba rnam bzhi'i rim pa yis/ /dpe yi 'od gsal 'char bar shogalte bar ting 'dzin sems pa yi/ /'od kyis rjes gzhig sgom pa las/ /'jug cing ldang ba rdzogs rim che/ /rnal 'byor chen po sgom par shog /de yis sgyu ma'i sku sgrub cing*/ de yang 'od gsal bar zhugs nas/ /zung 'jug mngon gyur gsang sngags kyi/ /spyod pas rdzogs 'tshang rgya bar shog/mi shigs thig ler rlung thim pa/ /sa bon bcas pa'i bdag byin rlabs/ /sa bon med par rdor zlas te/ /bdag byin rlabs pa'i rim sgom shog/dbu ma'i mas snar sa bon bcas/ /dbang po 'khor lo sna tshogs pa/ /yas snar sa bon med pa ste/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i rim sgom shog/sgoms dang dngos dang rgyas 'debs dang*/ /de bas bde ba cher 'dren pa/ /phyag rgya bzhi las 'khor lo 'gengs/ / nor bu 'gengs pa'i rim thob shog /tshangs pa'i me ni 'bar ba las/ /zhi bde bla med yang dag thob/ /gtum mo rlung rnams 'khor lor brtan/ /steng du 'bar 'dzin rim thob shog /rjes gzhig rim pas 'jug dang ldang*/ /dpe don ye shes snang phyogs la/

/ma dag dag pa'i dbye ba yis/ /bsam mi khyab rim thob par shog /'di sgrub thogs med mthu ldan pa/ /sum su rtsa gnyis yul mchog gi /dpa' bo lha mo 'khor bcas kyis/ /g.yel med rtag tu grogs mdzad shog /snying dbus 'od gsal rtag shar bas/ /chos kun rang sems skye med thob/ /rnam par mi rtog rnam pa kun/ /mchog ldan thugs kyi rdo rjer shog /zhu ba'i reg bdes yid rab bde/ /de yis sems kyi rang bzhin nyid/ /bde ba mngon gyur sgrib kun spangs/ /ye shes rdo rje thob par shog /nam mkha' las byung nam mkha'i sgra/ /don yang lhun grub stong par mnyam/ /chos la rdzogs par longs spyod pa/ /gsung gi rdo rje thob par shog /mtshan dpes spras pa rlung sems kyi/ /sku mchog dbang phyug brgyad dang ldan/ /dngos po kun khyab gar yang phyin/ /sku yi rdo rje thob par shog /de las gzhan yang bdag cag rnams/ / dam tshig kun la gus par gnas/ /rim pa gnyis po rtag tu sgom/ /rdo rje'i zlas la yang dag gnas/ /sngags dang nang la gzhol ba yis/ /tshe 'dir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /gal te rang gi skyon nyid kyis/ /tshe 'dir sangs rgyas ma thob na/ /bla ma lha yi thugs rje yis/ /'pho tshe dngos grub thob par shog /de tshe khrag 'thung rnal 'byor mas/ /me tog rgyal mtshan ba dan sogs/ /rol mo glu yi sbyor ba yis/ /mkha' spyod gnas su 'khrid par shog/de ma thag tu ting 'dzin thob/ /sgrib spangs yon tan yang dag rdzogs/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i lus thob nas/ /sa rnams mthar phyin sangs rgyas shog /shin tu skal ba dman gyur pas/ /der ma grub na skye ba dang*/ /skye bar chos ldan rgyal por gyur/ /skye ba bdun gyi nges 'grub shog /skye dang skye bar blo ldan zhing*/ /rigs bzang nga rgyal med pa dang*/ /snying rje che zhing bla mar gus/ /bde mchog dam tshig la gnas shog /mgo bor bla ma'i cod pan 'chang*/ /lag tu rdo rje dril bu 'dzin/

/ngag tu gsang sngags rgyal po bzla/ /yid kyis zung 'jug sgom par shog /bla ma 'khor lo bde mchog dang*/ /rdo rje'i theg dang 'bral med shog /rdo rje slob dpon he ru ka'i/ /zhabs pad spyi bor gnas par shog /gang tshe rje btsun lta ba dang*/ /cung zad dri bar 'dod na yang*/ /mgon po slob dpon khrag 'thung mchog /gegs med par yang mthong bar shog /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i/ sems can kun don sgrub pa'i phyir/ /'khor lo sdom pa'i spyod mdzad pa/ / bdag gi spyod pa'ang de 'drar shog /bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang*/ /dus gsum dge ba thams cad dang*/ /bde ba cung zad gang yod pas/ /'gro kun phan bdes 'byor bar shog /'gro rnams mi dge sdug bsngal yang*/ /yid du mi 'ong ci yod pa/ /de kun bdag la smin gyur nas/ /sdig sdug kun dang bral bar shog /bdag ni mthong thos dran dang reg /de rnams byang chub mchog nge shog / gnod cing gdug par byed kun kyang*/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa myur thob shog khyad par 'khor lo sdom pa la/ /ma dad bsod nams dman pa rnams/ /sna tshogs thabs kyi rab btul nas/ /lam 'dis rdo rje 'dzin 'god shog /mdor na skye ba thams cad du/ /bla ma mchog gis rjes bzung nas/ /rim gnyis sdom shing dngos grub gnyis/ /thob nas sems can smin byed shog khu rdul spyi bor nor bur brten/ /rnam pa kun ldan mi 'gyur bde/ /sangs rgyas ye shes mngon gyur nas/ /tshe 'dir sku gnyis 'byor bar shog /rang bzhin 'od gsal rnam shes 'das/ /chos kun gos med he ru ka /ma skyes sangs rgyas sems can bral/ / 'du mi byed pa rta yi rgyal/ /rtag chad las grol mnyam pa nyid/ /'gyur med ye shes gzi brjid rgyal/ /mi 'gyur a yig ming dang bral/ /ming thams cad pa gang dbang phyug /phra rab rdul gyi chos nyid 'das/ /pra phab rang bzhin rtag pa'o/ khyab bdag kun mkhyen sgyu ma ni/

/bde chen rdo rjes sems 'grub shog /de ltar smon lam de dag kun/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis 'grub par mdzod/ /'khor lo sdom pa'i lam bzang 'di/ /phyogs dus kun tu dar bar shog /ces pa 'di ni bhū ba ri pa'i rgyun bshags sogs 'phags yul dang*/ phyogs 'di'i mkhas grub mang po'i gsung rab la bsten/ /go bde zhing tshig zor yang ba lhur byas pa ste/ de yang dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rgya bod kyi mkhas pa mang po'i thugs rje la brten nas/ gsang sngags nges don gyi gnad mang po go zhing*/ rgya bod kyi mkhas grub du mas legs par gsungs pa rnams kyang mthong nas tā ra nā tha kun dga' snying pos rang lo nyer gsum pa snron gyi yar ngo'i tshes brgyad la mgo brtsams nas tshes bcu ste thun gsum la yongs su sbyar ba'o// //rgyud don sdom gyi tshul du legs sbyar nas/ /bstod pa 'di ni tā ra nā tha yis/ /rang gi rtog pa glu ru blangs pa ste/ /dpyod ldan rnams kyis 'di la rtogs par 'os/ zhes pa ni 'khor lo sdom pa'i bstod pas rtogs pa brjod pa'o/ / 'di ni grub pa'i slob dpon nag po spyod pa'i lugs kyi rim gnyis dang gtso bor bstun nas sbyar ba las/ gal te lū yi pa sogs kyi bstod pa bya 'dod na zhal phyag gi skabs dang*/ bskyed rim gyi smon lam 'don pa sgyur bas lhag ma 'di nyid kyis chog par bya'o// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/bde mchog bstod chen dngos grub 'byung gnas bzhugs/ -PAGE 4--PAGE 5--PAGE 1-
